intro: Sudan has around 50 million people from many ethnic groups.

chapters.title: People
text: Arabic and English are official, and many other languages are spoken, including Nubian, Beja and Fur. Most people are Sunni Muslim.
War has forced millions to flee within Sudan and to Chad, Egypt and South Sudan, and famine has spread.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Khartoum, Omdurman and Khartoum North form the capital area, badly damaged by the war.

keyTerms.meaning: A severe lack of food across a region.
